"""The same check, comparative.

The Casimirs are conserved by construction on this structure, so their drift
along this trajectory measures what the integrator did at this precision over
this length. The candidate is compared against that, and both numbers come out
of the same run. The floor moves with a stiff parameter set and an absolute
constant cannot.
"""


def integral_is_conserved(drift, casimir_noise_floor):
    return drift <= casimir_noise_floor * 10
